documented_rule.meaning: Referral consideration rule; not a diagnosis threshold

documentation.citation: Thabtah, F. (2017). UCI adult autism screening dataset (426); CC BY 4.0.
documentation.label_evidence: The ARFF declares Class/ASD as NO/YES. The attached UCI description calls the screening score automatically computed; it does not explicitly document target generation or clinician verification.
limitations: Item direction encoding is inferred rather than fully documented; sum-score agreement can support but not prove this encoding.
Matching predictor records do not establish participant identity.
Self-selected screening records do not establish independently assessed clinical outcomes.
documentation.feature_rationale: Residual features mirror the existing adult demo's age and five categorical fields. Family history, app use, and age_desc are excluded for comparability, not on evidence of irrelevance.
